thread:
sarah-design: Quick a11y pass on Notifications panel — found 4 issues: screen reader verbosity for status updates, focus ring clipped by sticky header, tertiary button contrast too low in dense rows, keyboard trap in filter dropdown. Screenshot + voiceover clip attached. Can we triage? omar-a11y: Thanks — can you paste minimal repro steps and which SR you used (VoiceOver/NVDA/JAWS)? sarah-design: Repro steps: 1) Console > Notifications 2) Tab to a notification 3) Press ArrowRight to expand details 4) Tab to filter dropdown and press ArrowDown. VoiceOver (mac) used. kevin-eng: Repro'ed on Chrome+mac VO. Focus ring is clipped because `.notifications-header` has `overflow: hidden` for the sticky shadow. Quick CSS options: ` .notifications-header { overflow: visible; } ` or on the focused item: ` .notification-item:focus { outline-offset: 3px; } ` Also avoid `transform` on the parent — it creates a new stacking context and clips outlines. laura-ux: Copy nit: close icon uses `aria-label="dismiss"`. Recommend `aria-label="Close notification"` for clarity. Also `.btn-tertiary` text contrast is ~2.8:1 in compact rows — needs to reach 4.5:1 for AA on small text or 3:1 at least for larger. a11y-bot: Automated scan results: notifications-panel — contrast failure on `.btn-tertiary` (WCAG AA fail), focusable element overlapping header (focus clip/trap). Report: https://ci.internal/reports/1802/notifications-panel.json :eyes: :warning: omar-a11y: Priorities: 1) Focus clipping/trap (kevin), 2) Tertiary CTA contrast (laura), 3) SR verbosity / live region (sarah), 4) Filter dropdown keyboard handling. Proposed owners: @kevin-eng, @laura-ux, @sarah-design. kevin-eng: I'll take focus clipping + dropdown trap. Implementation notes: add `aria-expanded` on trigger, ensure dropdown uses `role="menu"` only if arrow-key behavior enabled; otherwise `role="listbox"`. Ensure Escape closes dropdown and returns focus to trigger. Avoid focus locking — tab should exit. sarah-design: For the SR updates: wrap status messages in `
` and debounce batch updates (250–500ms) so VoiceOver doesn't announce a flood of items. I'll add an automated VoiceOver test in the eval suite. laura-ux: I'll propose copy change + two color swatches that hit >=4.5:1 (darken text and slightly increase bg) and post options here. omar-a11y: Can we target a patch branch by EOD Fri? I'm assigning tasks in Asana and will add acceptance criteria: keyboard nav with arrow/escape, focus visible outside sticky header, SR announcements debounced, tertiary CTA contrast >=4.5:1. :raised_hands: kevin-eng: Opening PR today for the focus/overflow fixes, will link when ready. sarah-design: Uploaded VO clip for the noisy announcements if anyone wants to hear exact behavior. Thanks all!
